purpose: Implement a source-bound, explicitly assisted first-frame court anchor primitive for the brief-authorized future product flow; preserve separate automatic evidence.

inputContract.landmarks: 6..14 strictly increasing distinct canonical indices, each with a distinct finite in-bounds imagePx and visible=true; hidden or duplicate points are rejected
inputContract.provenance: Payload annotator kind/identifier/method must equal caller-established actual actor provenance; LOCAL_OPERATOR/LOCAL_POINT_SUBMISSION, AI_AGENT/AI_IMAGE_REVIEW and TEST/SYNTHETIC_TEST are distinct. USER/HUMAN_CLICK is not an accepted actor kind; no authenticated human identity is asserted by this local primitive.

fit.suppliedPoints: Only indexed visible correspondences enter calibration; no detector or generated points fill missing supplied observations
fit.derivedPoints: Full 14-point canonical template projected through the assisted fit solely for future registration/rendering, with every point marked DERIVED_FROM_ASSISTED_FIT
fit.projectionChecks: Finite invertible homography and homogeneous denominators with one nonzero sign over every canonical landmark; a horizon-crossing full court is rejected
fit.invalidFit: Return explicit assisted rejection, no effective template, and preserved automatic evidence; never silently fall back while tagging the result assisted

evidence.automatic: Original detector points and supplied automatic CourtCalibration are retained independently
evidence.assisted: Normalized payload digest, exact source binding, actual annotator, supplied indexed points, sparse inlier mask, supplied-landmark fit and separate derived template

futureWorkerRequirement: Use the byte-identical normalized source video shown by the anchor endpoint, bind its SHA-256 and decode its actual frame 0 for pixel verification. Do not re-normalize/re-encode the original and assume the same frame or source hash. Copy/reuse bound normalization metadata and source-frame mapping with independently verified lineage.
testScope: Exact trusted source and annotator binding, including boolean/type/size/hash validation and rejected extras
Finite/native-bounds/visibility/indices/duplicate-point guards and duplicate JSON key rejection
Projective recovery on unseen canonical landmarks from six sparse supplied points using independently generated geometry
Six-point fit cannot pass after losing one required inlier; seven-point fit can preserve six consistent points without changing thresholds
Degenerate sparse court correspondences and full-template horizon crossings reject without suppressing automatic evidence
Automatic calibration evidence remains separate and unmodified, including nonfinite detector components represented explicitly as null
Actual decoded uint8 BGR frame hashing is stride-independent and changes with pixel content
Local operator/AI/test provenance cannot be relabeled as verified USER/HUMAN_CLICK, and no payload can inject speed/3D/accuracy authority
limitations: Visibility and landmark meaning are supplied assertions, not independent human truth
Actor labels distinguish declared local operator, AI and test provenance; they do not verify a username or authenticated identity
No real video, model, worker, API or UI execution is included in preparing this primitive
Passing isolated geometry/contract tests cannot prove player, court, speed or 3D accuracy
Existing CourtPlayerTracker can still select officials/spectators after a correct court fit; original-frame positive and negative controls remain required
